scene: Dinner table in the evening. Dad sits at screen-left; Child sits at screen-right; both rest their hands on the table between turns. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot across the table corner with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child tells his news with lively but calm pride; Dad reacts with warm surprise; both share gentle laughs at the end.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad and Child sit at the table with hands resting on the tabletop.
clips.action: Dad leans toward Child with his question. Child holds up two fingers for two things; Dad points at the first finger to ask for the first one.
clips.end: Child keeps two fingers up, ready to start.

clips.start: Child keeps two fingers up, ready to start.
clips.action: Child wiggles his fingertips downward like rain while telling the weather song. Dad echoes the surprise with open hands and asks for the second thing; Child digs one finger in a small circle on the table like tunnel digging.
clips.end: Both hands rest on the table; Dad smiles wide.

clips.start: Both hands rest on the table; Dad smiles wide.
clips.action: Dad raises one finger for each title — rain singer, tunnel digger. Child places two fists side by side on the table for the two tunnel rooms and taps each once; they share a warm laugh.
clips.end: Both sit back relaxed with happy faces and hands resting on the table.
